newsitem.title: USA: Sara Lee files $500 mln equities, debt shelf.
newsitem.headline: Sara Lee files $500 mln equities, debt shelf.

text.p: Sara Lee Corp said Friday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $500 million in debt securities, debt warrants, common stock, stock warrants, preferred stock and currency warrants.

Net proceeds will be available for general corporate purposes and may be used for repayment of short-term debt, future acquisitions, capital expenditures and working capital, Sara Lee said in the filing.
The company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois and founded in 1939 is an international manufacturer and marketer of food and consumer packaged goods.
